query: WITH object_index AS ( SELECT 'character' AS object_type, id, name || IIF(deleted, ' (deleted)', '') AS name, description, gm_notes, storyteller_notes FROM character WHERE world_id = ? UNION ALL SELECT 'connection', connection.id, from_location.name || ' <-> ' || to_location.name || IIF(connection.deleted, ' (deleted)', ''), connection.description, connection.gm_notes, connection.storyteller_notes FROM connection JOIN location AS from_location ON from_location.id = connection.from_location_id JOIN location AS to_location ON to_location.id = connection.to_location_id WHERE connection.world_id = ? UNION ALL SELECT 'group', id, name || IIF(deleted, ' (deleted)', ''), description, gm_notes, storyteller_notes FROM "group" WHERE world_id = ? UNION ALL SELECT 'item', id, name || IIF(deleted, ' (deleted)', ''), description, gm_notes, storyteller_notes FROM item WHERE world_id = ? UNION ALL SELECT 'item_type', id, name || IIF(deleted, ' (deleted)', ''), description, gm_notes, storyteller_notes FROM item_type WHERE world_id = ? UNION ALL SELECT 'location', id, name || IIF(deleted, ' (deleted)', ''), description, gm_notes, storyteller_notes FROM location WHERE world_id = ? ) SELECT object_type, id, name, description, gm_notes, storyteller_notes FROM object_index WHERE (? IS NULL OR object_type = ?) AND (? IS NULL OR id = ?) AND (? IS NULL OR name LIKE '%' || ? || '%' OR object_type LIKE '%' || ? || '%' OR CAST(id AS TEXT) LIKE '%' || ? || '%') AND (? IS NULL OR object_type > ? OR (object_type = ? AND id > ?)) ORDER BY object_type, id LIMIT ?
